message_source_quote: The white-bear paper in the reading list (Raman et al.) supplied the mechanism: a concept-agnostic *stance* direction in the concept-assembly band (L20–24) at a *large* dose, where the gain is **computed by the layers above the band**, not read back.
writeup_source_quote: Motivation: the white-bear result in the reading list showed the think/don't-think stance contrast, at a large dose in the concept-assembly band, makes implied concepts readable through the plain J-lens; its hold-versus-mention contrast failed.

claims_about_writeup.quote: One honest caveat, stated in both notes and the contribution: the steering protocol (band, dose, positions) is the published white-bear one; the novelty is the new monitoring stance, the stance-space map, the self-contained 16-pair recipe, and the higher after-band pass@10.
claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up's Motivation section attributes the band and large-dose regime to the white-bear result, and separately lists the new monitoring stance, the self-contained 16-pair recipe, and the higher pass@10 as its distinguishing points, matching this summary; the write-up does note the monitoring direction 'peaks at a larger dose' than the published one, a minor nuance that does not contradict the overall characterization.
Refers to the write-up file's existence and approximate length; nothing in the write-up content contradicts this description, and it is the same document being evaluated.
